__fixture.note: Peakbagger rows for every curated Peaks list. All rows from the 2026-08-21b fixture are carried across unchanged. Four new public list tables (200, 5170, 5410 and 5521) were read on 2026-08-22. The new rows carry names, page order, rank, elevation and peak ID. Their map marker feed was unavailable, so the importer uses reviewed ISO country and state scopes to prevent cross-region name matches.
